title.en: AN ACT DECLARING BARRIOS OF IGANG, KUL-LA-LABO, BULINAW, NASI-LANNAN, KANYOGAN, WAWANG, BANKO, TAL-LAK, AGUG, LOG, AND TARANKA, NOW A PART OF THE MUNICIPALITY OF KABAGAN NUEVO, PROVINCE OF ISABELA, TO BE A NEW MUNICIPALITY UNDER THE NAME OF SANTO TOMAS.
title.orig: AN ACT DECLARING BARRIOS OF IGANG, KUL-LA-LABO, BULINAW, NASI-LANNAN, KANYOGAN, WAWANG, BANKO, TAL-LAK, AGUG, LOG, AND TARANKA, NOW A PART OF THE MUNICIPALITY OF KABAGAN NUEVO, PROVINCE OF ISABELA, TO BE A NEW MUNICIPALITY UNDER THE NAME OF SANTO TOMAS.
title.vi: Đạo luật tuyên bố các barangay Igang, Kul-La-Labo, Bulinaw, Nasi-Lannan, Kanyogan, Wawang, Banko, Tal-Lak, Agug, Log và Taranka thuộc Thị trấn Kabagan Nuevo, Tỉnh Isabela trở thành một Thị trấn mới mang tên Santo Tomas
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติประกาศให้บารังไกย์อีกังกุลลาลาโบบูลินาวนาซิลานนานกันโยกันวาวังบังโกตัลลักอากูกโล็กและตาแรงกาซึ่งปัจจุบันเป็นส่วนหนึ่งของเทศบาลกาบากันนูเอโวจังหวัดอิซาเบลาเป็นเทศบาลใหม่ภายใต้ชื่อซานโตโตมาส
title.id: Undang-Undang menyatakan bahwa barangay Igang, Kul-La-Labo, Bulinaw, Nasi-Lannan, Kanyogan, Wawang, Banko, Tal-Lak, Agug, Log, dan Taranka yang kini merupakan bagian dari Kotamadya Kabagan Nuevo, Provinsi Isabela menjadi Kotamadya baru bernama Santo Tomas
title.ms: Akta mengisytiharkan bahawa barangay Igang, Kul-La-Labo, Bulinaw, Nasi-Lannan, Kanyogan, Wawang, Banko, Tal-Lak, Agug, Log dan Taranka yang kini merupakan sebahagian daripada Perbandaran Kabagan Nuevo, Wilayah Isabela menjadi perbandaran baharu di bawah nama Santo Tomas

text.en:
The barrios of Igang, Kul-la-labo, Bulinaw, Nasi-lannan, Kanyogan, Wawang, Banko, Tal-lak,
Agug, Log, and Taranka, now forming a part of the municipality of Kabagan Nuevo, Province of Isabela, are
hereby separated from said municipality, and shall be organized under the Municipal Code into a new
municipality under the name of Santo Tomas. The provincial supervisor of Isabela shall survey at once the
new municipality, in order to establish in a definite and precise manner the boundary lines which separate it
from the adjacent municipalities, and shall report to the provincial board the results of such survey. After the
provincial supervisor has established the boundary lines of the municipality and has reported to the
provincial board, a municipal election shall be held in such municipality in accordance with the provisions of
articles ninety-one, ninety-two, ninety-three, and ninety-four of the Municipal Code.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 3, 1902.
